statements.purchase_rate:
WITH "t7" AS (
  SELECT
    "t5"."unit_id",
    "t5"."experiment_id",
    "t5"."group_id",
    MIN("t5"."ts") AS "first_exposure_ts"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "t1"."unit_id",
      "t1"."ts",
      "t1"."group_id",
      COALESCE('sql_golden', 'sql_golden') AS "experiment_id"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        user_id AS unit_id,
        ts,
        group_id
      FROM events
      WHERE
        event = 'exposure'
    ) AS "t1"
    WHERE
      "t1"."unit_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "t1"."ts" IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST("t1"."ts" AS DATE) >= MAKE_DATE(2024, 1, 1)
      AND CAST("t1"."ts" AS DATE) <= MAKE_DATE(2024, 1, 31)
  ) AS "t5"
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
), "t13" AS (
  SELECT
    "t9"."unit_id",
    "t9"."experiment_id",
    "t9"."group_id",
    "t9"."first_exposure_ts"
  FROM "t7" AS "t9"
  SEMI JOIN (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM (
      SELECT
        "t8"."unit_id",
        "t8"."experiment_id",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "t8"."group_id") AS "n_groups",
        BOOL_OR(CAST("t8"."group_id" IS NULL AS BOOLEAN)) AS "has_null"
      FROM "t7" AS "t8"
      GROUP BY
        1,
        2
    ) AS "t10"
    WHERE
      "t10"."n_groups" = 1 AND NOT (
        "t10"."has_null"
      )
  ) AS "t12"
    ON "t9"."unit_id" = "t12"."unit_id" AND "t9"."experiment_id" = "t12"."experiment_id"
)
SELECT
  "t33"."experiment_id",
  "t33"."metric",
  "t33"."group_id",
  "t33"."n",
  "t33"."ref_y",
  "t33"."cy1",
  "t33"."cy2",
  "t33"."ref_x",
  "t33"."cx1",
  "t33"."cx2",
  "t33"."cxy",
  "t33"."ref_den",
  "t33"."cden1",
  "t33"."cden2",
  "t33"."cden3",
  "t33"."cyden",
  "t33"."cxden",
  "t33"."winsor_lower_percentile",
  "t33"."winsor_upper_percentile",
  "t33"."winsor_lower_bound",
  "t33"."winsor_upper_bound",
  "t33"."winsor_n",
  "t33"."winsor_n_lower",
  "t33"."winsor_n_upper",
  "t33"."successes",
  "t33"."sum_d",
  "t33"."cyd",
  "t33"."cy2d",
  "t33"."cxd",
  CASE WHEN "t33"."ref_x" IS NOT NULL THEN 'covariate' ELSE CAST(NULL AS TEXT) END AS "x_role"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "t32"."experiment_id",
    "t32"."metric",
    "t32"."group_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "n",
    MAX("t32"."ref_y") AS "ref_y",
    SUM("t32"."y" - "t32"."ref_y") AS "cy1",
    SUM((
      "t32"."y" - "t32"."ref_y"
    ) * (
      "t32"."y" - "t32"."ref_y"
    )) AS "cy2",
    MAX("t32"."ref_x") AS "ref_x",
    SUM("t32"."x" - "t32"."ref_x") AS "cx1",
    SUM((
      "t32"."x" - "t32"."ref_x"
    ) * (
      "t32"."x" - "t32"."ref_x"
    )) AS "cx2",
    SUM((
      "t32"."x" - "t32"."ref_x"
    ) * (
      "t32"."y" - "t32"."ref_y"
    )) AS "cxy",
    MAX("t32"."ref_den") AS "ref_den",
    SUM("t32"."y_den" - "t32"."ref_den") AS "cden1",
    SUM((
      "t32"."y_den" - "t32"."ref_den"
    ) * (
      "t32"."y_den" - "t32"."ref_den"
    )) AS "cden2",
    SUM(
      (
        "t32"."y_den" - "t32"."ref_den"
      ) * (
        "t32"."y_den" - "t32"."ref_den"
      ) * (
        "t32"."y_den" - "t32"."ref_den"
      )
    ) AS "cden3",
    SUM((
      "t32"."y" - "t32"."ref_y"
    ) * (
      "t32"."y_den" - "t32"."ref_den"
    )) AS "cyden",
    SUM((
      "t32"."x" - "t32"."ref_x"
    ) * (
      "t32"."y_den" - "t32"."ref_den"
    )) AS "cxden",
    MAX("t32"."winsor_lower_percentile") AS "winsor_lower_percentile",
    MAX("t32"."winsor_upper_percentile") AS "winsor_upper_percentile",
    MAX("t32"."winsor_lower_bound") AS "winsor_lower_bound",
    MAX("t32"."winsor_upper_bound") AS "winsor_upper_bound",
    SUM("t32"."winsor_n") AS "winsor_n",
    SUM("t32"."winsor_n_lower") AS "winsor_n_lower",
    SUM("t32"."winsor_n_upper") AS "winsor_n_upper",
    SUM("t32"."successes") AS "successes",
    SUM("t32"."d") AS "sum_d",
    SUM("t32"."d" * (
      "t32"."y" - "t32"."ref_y"
    )) AS "cyd",
    SUM("t32"."d" * (
      "t32"."y" - "t32"."ref_y"
    ) * (
      "t32"."y" - "t32"."ref_y"
    )) AS "cy2d",
    SUM("t32"."d" * (
      "t32"."x" - "t32"."ref_x"
    )) AS "cxd"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "t31"."unit_id",
      "t31"."experiment_id",
      "t31"."group_id",
      "t31"."metric",
      "t31"."y",
      "t31"."x",
      "t31"."y_den",
      "t31"."d",
      "t31"."y_raw",
      "t31"."winsor_lower_percentile",
      "t31"."winsor_upper_percentile",
      "t31"."winsor_lower_bound",
      "t31"."winsor_upper_bound",
      "t31"."winsor_n",
      "t31"."winsor_n_lower",
      "t31"."winsor_n_upper",
      "t31"."successes",
      AVG("t31"."y") OVER (
        PARTITION BY "t31"."experiment_id", "t31"."metric", "t31"."group_id"
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS "ref_y",
      AVG("t31"."x") OVER (
        PARTITION BY "t31"."experiment_id", "t31"."metric", "t31"."group_id"
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS "ref_x",
      AVG("t31"."y_den") OVER (
        PARTITION BY "t31"."experiment_id", "t31"."metric", "t31"."group_id"
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS "ref_den"
    FROM (
      SELECT
        "t30"."unit_id",
        "t30"."experiment_id",
        "t30"."group_id",
        "t30"."metric",
        "t30"."y",
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "x",
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "y_den",
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "d",
        "t30"."y" AS "y_raw",
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "winsor_lower_percentile",
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "winsor_upper_percentile",
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "winsor_lower_bound",
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "winsor_upper_bound",
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "winsor_n",
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "winsor_n_lower",
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "winsor_n_upper",
        CASE
          WHEN "t30"."metric" IN ('purchase_rate')
          THEN CAST("t30"."y" AS BIGINT)
          ELSE CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
        END AS "successes"
      FROM (
        SELECT
          "t29"."unit_id",
          "t29"."experiment_id",
          "t29"."group_id",
          "t29"."metric",
          CAST(CAST(BOOL_OR(CAST("t29"."n_events" > 0 AS BOOLEAN)) AS INT) AS DOUBLE) AS "y"
        FROM (
          SELECT
            "t28"."unit_id",
            "t28"."experiment_id",
            "t28"."group_id",
            "t28"."first_exposure_ts",
            "t28"."first_exposure_date",
            "t28"."ds",
            "t28"."n_events",
            "t28"."sum_value",
            "t28"."min_value",
            "t28"."max_value",
            'purchase_rate' AS "metric"
          FROM (
            SELECT
              "t18"."unit_id",
              "t18"."experiment_id",
              "t18"."group_id",
              "t18"."first_exposure_ts",
              "t18"."first_exposure_date",
              "t25"."ds",
              COALESCE("t27"."n_events", 0) AS "n_events",
              COALESCE("t27"."sum_value", 0.0) AS "sum_value",
              COALESCE("t27"."min_value", 0.0) AS "min_value",
              COALESCE("t27"."max_value", 0.0) AS "max_value"
            FROM (
              SELECT
                "t14"."unit_id",
                "t14"."experiment_id",
                "t14"."group_id",
                "t14"."first_exposure_ts",
                CAST("t14"."first_exposure_ts" AS DATE) AS "first_exposure_date"
              FROM "t13" AS "t14"
            ) AS "t18"
            LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT
                "t21"."unit_id",
                "t21"."experiment_id",
                "t21"."_day_offsets" AS "day_offset",
                "t21"."first_exposure_date" + TO_DAYS("t21"."_day_offsets") AS "ds"
              FROM (
                SELECT
                  "t20".*
                  REPLACE ("ibis_table_unnest_column_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaay" AS "_day_offsets")
                FROM (
                  SELECT
                    "t14"."unit_id",
                    "t14"."experiment_id",
                    "t14"."group_id",
                    "t14"."first_exposure_ts",
                    CAST("t14"."first_exposure_ts" AS DATE) AS "first_exposure_date",
                    RANGE(
                      0,
                      GREATEST(
                        COALESCE(
                          DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST("t14"."first_exposure_ts" AS DATE), MAKE_DATE(2024, 1, 31)) + 1,
                          0
                        ),
                        0
                      ),
                      1
                    ) AS "_day_offsets"
                  FROM "t13" AS "t14"
                ) AS "t20"
                CROSS JOIN UNNEST("t20"."_day_offsets") AS "ibis_table_unnest_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa4"("ibis_table_unnest_column_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaay")
              ) AS "t21"
            ) AS "t25"
              ON "t18"."unit_id" = "t25"."unit_id"
              AND "t18"."experiment_id" = "t25"."experiment_id"
            LEFT OUTER JOIN (
              SELECT
                "t23"."unit_id",
                "t23"."ds",
                'purchase_rate' AS "source_key",
                "t23"."n_events",
                "t23"."sum_value",
                "t23"."min_value",
                "t23"."max_value"
              FROM (
                SELECT
                  "t22"."unit_id",
                  "t22"."ds",
                  COUNT(*) AS "n_events",
                  SUM("t22"."value") AS "sum_value",
                  MIN("t22"."value") AS "min_value",
                  MAX("t22"."value") AS "max_value"
                FROM (
                  SELECT
                    "t19"."unit_id",
                    "t19"."ts",
                    "t19"."metric",
                    "t19"."value",
                    CAST("t19"."ts" AS DATE) AS "ds"
                  FROM (
                    SELECT
                      "t4"."unit_id",
                      "t4"."ts",
                      "t4"."metric",
                      "t4"."value",
                      "t17"."first_exposure_ts"
                    FROM (
                      SELECT
                        "t0"."user_id" AS "unit_id",
                        "t0"."ts",
                        'purchase_rate' AS "metric",
                        CAST(1 AS DOUBLE) AS "value"
                      FROM (
                        SELECT
                          *
                        FROM events
                      ) AS "t0"
                      WHERE
                        "t0"."event" = 'purchase'
                    ) AS "t4"
                    INNER JOIN (
                      SELECT DISTINCT
                        "t14"."unit_id",
                        "t14"."first_exposure_ts"
                      FROM "t13" AS "t14"
                    ) AS "t17"
                      ON "t4"."unit_id" = "t17"."unit_id"
                  ) AS "t19"
                  WHERE
                    "t19"."ts" > "t19"."first_exposure_ts"
                ) AS "t22"
                GROUP BY
                  1,
                  2
              ) AS "t23"
            ) AS "t27"
              ON "t18"."unit_id" = "t27"."unit_id" AND "t25"."ds" = "t27"."ds"
          ) AS "t28"
          WHERE
            "t28"."ds" IS NOT NULL
            AND COALESCE(
              (
                "t28"."first_exposure_date" + TO_DAYS(6)
              ) <= LEAST(
                MAKE_DATE(2024, 1, 31),
                COALESCE(
                  (
                    SELECT
                      MAX(CAST("t2"."ts" AS DATE)) AS "Max(Cast(ts, date))"
                    FROM (
                      SELECT
                        "t0"."user_id" AS "unit_id",
                        "t0"."ts",
                        "t0"."event",
                        "t0"."group_id",
                        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS "experiment_id"
                      FROM (
                        SELECT
                          *
                        FROM events
                      ) AS "t0"
                      WHERE
                        "t0"."event" = 'purchase'
                    ) AS "t2"
                  ),
                  MAKE_DATE(9999, 12, 31)
                )
              ),
              FALSE
            )
            AND "t28"."ds" < (
              "t28"."first_exposure_date" + TO_DAYS(7)
            )
        ) AS "t29"
        GROUP BY
          1,
          2,
          3,
          4
      ) AS "t30"
    ) AS "t31"
  ) AS "t32"
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
) AS "t33"
